en.title: Echoes of Steel, Memories of Oblivion
en.premise: A massive city shrouded in steam. In this world, people depend on the 'Memory Market,' a place where they must sell off their most precious memories just to survive. Masago, a ronin whose memories of a comrade who once shared his samurai pride have been stolen, turns his blade against the colossal power that toys with human memory. Cutting through assassins equipped with steam-powered prosthetics, he plunges into a whirlwind of battle in search of the lost truth and the place where his soul resides.

zh.title: 钢铁的回响，遗忘的记忆
zh.premise: 蒸汽弥漫的巨大都市。人们依赖着名为“记忆市场”的场所，为了生存而变卖珍贵的记忆。浪人真砂曾与挚友一同守护武士的荣耀，如今却被夺走了关于友人的记忆。他将利刃指向玩弄记忆的庞大权力。他斩杀那些拥有蒸汽义肢的刺客，踏入战斗的漩涡，只为寻回失落的真相，以及自己灵魂的归宿。
